title: Obtain the first registration record matching the number
goal: knows that find returns a single match and handles the case of not being found.
summary: The registration list is arranged according to the entry time, and only the first entry with repeated numbers is read. Presentation layer requires an object or null.
tasks: completes findRecord(records, serial), strictly matches the number by id and returns the first record.

example.code:
const records = [{ name: 'A', done: false }, { name: 'B', done: true }];
records.find((item) => item.done); // { name: 'B', done: true }
example.note: Returns the original item when find is successful, or undefined if there is no matching item.

hint: Combines search results with ?? null. The return value of filter is always an array.
